what: Every hand-inspected frame and its verdict. A script cannot recompute a human looking at a picture, so the verdicts live here and audit.py reports them and checks the sample sizes. The contact sheet for each row is committed beside this file.
method: Gated boxes were rendered on their frames, four per row, and inspected at full size. `on_subject` means the box lands on the object the scene folder name says is there. Rows are stratified across each clip's whole frame range, so a method cannot pass by being right only where it is easy.
why_it_matters: A labeller nobody audited is a detector nobody evaluated. Both routes below produced confident boxes; only the hand-check separates them.

checks.route: weak supervision: shipped MobileNet-SSD re-run with the class filter removed, gated on box aspect and background-subtraction motion
checks.verdict: 0/12. Every box landed on the same office-chair cluster with the Lite3 visible and unboxed beside it. The dim clip sweeps 28-83 mean luminance, so the empty-room median is not a background and the motion gate failed OPEN. THIS RESULT IS WHY THE WEAK-SUPERVISION ROUTE WAS ABANDONED.
12/12 in the stable-lighting clip. The same rule scoring 12/12 and 0/12 on two clips of the same robot in the same room is the argument against trusting it.

checks.route: owlv2 phrase -> box, sam2 box -> mask, at threshold 0.22
checks.label: lite3
checks.verdict: 16/16, both lighting conditions, near-broadside to far. Boxes are visibly tighter than the detector's because they are a silhouette rather than a regressed rectangle.

checks.route: owlv2 phrase -> box, sam2 box -> mask, at threshold 0.22
checks.scene: all four person scenes, 4 frames each
checks.label: person
checks.verdict: 16/16, including heavily truncated close-range people and the *-box-* scenes where a cardboard box is beside the person and is correctly NOT boxed.

checks.route: same pipeline at the FIRST threshold, 0.12
checks.label: person
checks.verdict: 9/16. Every failure scored 0.12-0.20 and every success 0.21+, which is what set the 0.22 floor. The floor comes from this hand-check, NOT from the score distribution.
12/12 boxes still enclose the robot after the warp, 4 per family.
17/17 land on the subject, which is what establishes the join and the full-frame pixel coordinate space. `perception.video_frame` is null in all 3,896 ticks, so the documented join does not exist.

totals.note: 44 = 16 lite3 + 16 person + 12 synthetic, all at the shipped 0.22 threshold. The superseded rows are kept deliberately: they are the measurement that chose the method.
